During 2025-26, the Company inaugurated a new, state-of-the-art R&D Centre in Navi Mumbai, strengthening product development, commercialisation and application-development capabilities. risks.note: The absence of an effective succession framework for key managerial personnel could impact leadership continuity, strategic execution, and stakeholder confidence.

Dependence on key suppliers or principals may lead to disruptions in procurement and business operations in the event of unexpected supply discontinuation; the distribution business relies on long-standing principal relationships, particularly in Japan, Germany and Thailand.

Failure to comply with applicable statutory, environmental, health, safety and regulatory requirements could result in penalties, operational restrictions and reputational impact; the Jhagadia manufacturing facility received GPCB closure directions during the year (later revoked), evidencing this exposure is live rather than theoretical.

Trade restrictions, tariffs, sanctions, geopolitical tensions and ongoing conflicts (including instability in the Middle East) may disrupt global supply chains, increase logistics costs, constrain raw-material availability and heighten uncertainty in international markets.

Volatility in foreign currency markets may adversely affect earnings and cash flows arising from import and export transactions, given the Company's reliance on cross-border sourcing and merchant exports.
Increasing competition from imported and domestic alternatives (including pricing pressure from Chinese imports noted for acrylamide solid) may pressure market share, pricing and profitability.

Product quality issues or defects in regulated international markets may expose the Company to financial liabilities, legal proceedings and reputational risk, relevant given its REACH/KKDIK-registered export markets.
